world.title: Delhi & Abu Dhabi discuss boost to IMEC, energy infra
world.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi engaged in discussions with Abu Dhabi officials to enhance the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) connectivity and strategic energy infrastructure. Modi emphasized the transformation of India-UAE relations in recent years, noting that both nations are elevating their ambitions to strengthen cooperation further. The talks aim to foster economic ties and infrastructure development between the countries.

world.title: Delhi rolls out red carpet for Pezeshkian, daughter: Rashtrapati Bhavan to shopping at BRICS Bazaar
world.summary: President Pezeshkian of Iran visited India, receiving a warm welcome, including activities at Rashtrapati Bhavan and the BRICS Bazaar. During discussions, the leaders emphasized the enduring friendship between Iran and India, with Pezeshkian expressing gratitude for Iran's support during India's BRICS presidency. The visit highlights the strengthening diplomatic ties and cooperation between the two nations.

business.title: Tata Sons NRC may ask chairman Chandrasekaran to reconsider decision to leave
business.summary: Tata Sons' Nomination and Remuneration Committee plans to request Chairman Chandrasekaran to reconsider his decision to leave. This follows the RBI's rejection of Tata Sons' NBFC license surrender, necessitating a mandatory listing. The committee believes his leadership is essential for stability during this transition period, emphasizing that his institutional knowledge will be crucial amid increased scrutiny.

business.title: Anthropic CEO outlines plan to slow AI development
business.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman have proposed a strategy to "pace the frontier" of AI development amid growing concerns about its risks. They emphasize the need for a more measured approach to AI advancements, reflecting a consensus among researchers regarding the potential dangers of rapid progress. The specifics of this pacing strategy remain to be detailed.

business.title: Sebi on Closing Auction Session after review: Latest update - New CAS rules
business.summary: Sebi has proposed five significant changes to the settlement price determination for derivatives on expiry days after reviewing the new closing auction session. These adjustments aim to enhance the accuracy and reliability of settlement prices for both index and single-stock derivatives. The proposed changes reflect Sebi's ongoing efforts to improve market mechanisms and ensure fair trading practices.

technology.title: Microsoft confirms Windows 11's update kills audio on some PCs, and the bugs keep piling up
technology.summary: Microsoft has confirmed that the Windows 11 update KB5124008 contains a bug that may disable audio and render microphones unresponsive on some PCs. The extent of the issue's impact on users remains unclear. Microsoft acknowledges the problem but has not yet provided a solution. Users are advised to monitor for updates regarding a potential fix.

technology.title: Motorola Edge 70 Neo Spotted on Geekbench and HDR10+ Database; Moto G47 Power 4GB
technology.summary: The Motorola Edge 70 Neo has been identified on Geekbench, featuring a Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 processor, 6GB RAM, and running Android 16. It is also listed among HDR10+ certified devices. Additionally, the Moto G47 Power has surfaced on the Italian site Epto, equipped with 4GB RAM and 128GB storage, although further specifications remain unspecified.

technology.title: Overwatch Announces New Hero Doctrine Coming to Season 5, Limited Trial Available Now
technology.summary: Blizzard announced the new Overwatch hero, Doctrine, at BlizzCon 2026. He will be available with the Season 5 update on October 6, 2026. Players can participate in a limited-time Hero Trial to play as Doctrine from September 12 to 14. This trial allows fans to experience the new Support Hero ahead of his official release.

sports.title: Mikel Arteta fumes at 'unacceptable' refereeing despite Arsenal victory as David Raya saves penalty in Sunderland clash
sports.summary: Mikel Arteta criticized refereeing standards after Arsenal's 2-0 victory over Sunderland, despite the win extending their streak to six matches. He expressed frustration with referee John Brooks' decision to award a penalty against Ezri Konsa for a challenge on Dan Ballard. Arteta deemed the officiating "unacceptable," highlighting his discontent with the penalty awarded during the match.

sports.title: Elena Rybakina defeats Aryna Sabalenka in US Open women’s singles final
sports.summary: Elena Rybakina won the US Open women's singles final, defeating two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka with a score of 6-4, 5-7, 6-2. This victory marks Rybakina's third Grand Slam title and elevates her to the world number one ranking. The match showcased Rybakina's strong performance, ultimately frustrating Sabalenka throughout the contest in New York.

sports.title: Ruthless Rybakina dethrones Sabalenka to claim first U.S. Open crown
sports.summary: Elena Rybakina won her first U.S. Open title by defeating two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka with a score of 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 in the final on September 12, 2026. Despite concerns over an ankle injury, Rybakina's performance secured her third Grand Slam crown, marking a significant achievement in her tennis career.

health.title: Seven cases in six days, swine flu tally rises to 17 in Jalandhar
health.summary: The number of swine flu cases in Jalandhar has increased to 17, with 10 reported as of September 6. In the last six days, seven new patients have tested positive for the virus. The local health authorities are monitoring the situation closely as the city experiences a steady rise in cases, prompting concerns among residents and health officials.

health.title: Bhutan Achieves WHO Validation Against Dog-Transmitted Rabies
health.summary: The World Health Organization confirmed on September 4, 2026, that Bhutan has eliminated dog-transmitted rabies as a public health threat. Since June 2023, there have been no recorded human deaths from this transmission route. While the virus remains present, the effectiveness of vaccination and accessible treatment has contributed significantly to this achievement in public health.

health.title: Aspirus emphasizes early recognition, teamwork during Sepsis Awareness Month
health.summary: Aspirus highlights the importance of early recognition and teamwork in addressing sepsis during Sepsis Awareness Month. Sepsis is a critical medical emergency resulting from the body's harmful response to infection, leading to tissue and organ damage. The CDC reports approximately 1.7 million adults and over 18,000 children are affected annually, underscoring the need for awareness and prompt treatment.

science.title: Earth Billions of Years Ago, Astronomers Say — BigGo Finance
science.summary: New research indicates that the young Sun may have consumed a super-Earth, a planet five to ten times Earth's mass, billions of years ago. This event potentially left behind chemical traces that could help resolve longstanding questions in solar physics. The study aims to provide insights into the early solar system's formation and the dynamics of planetary interactions.

science.title: Systematic interactome analysis identifies OCRL as a DENV 2 NS4A interactor that inhibits viral replication through a mechanism independent of global actin cytoskeleton rearrangement
science.summary: A study identified OCRL as a DENV 2 NS4A interactor that inhibits viral replication. Using mass spectrometry, 212 interacting proteins were found, including OCRL and helicases DDX18 and DDX41. OCRL's antiviral role was confirmed through siRNA knockdown, which increased DENV replication. The study suggests OCRL restricts DENV infection via lysosomal degradation, providing insights into host-virus interactions.

science.title: Persistent silicate weathering and carbon dioxide uptake in eolian drylands since the late Pliocene
science.summary: Research from the Chinese Loess Plateau indicates that variability in eolian mass accumulation rates, rather than silicate weathering intensity, primarily influences carbon dioxide consumption from silicate weathering. This process increased from approximately 3.7 to 18.8 Tg C yr⁻¹ between 4.0 and 1.0 Ma, then declined to about 13.0 Tg C yr⁻¹, aligning with late Pliocene atmospheric CO₂ reductions.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: September 13, 2026
entertainment.summary: On September 13, 2026, horoscopes suggest that Taurus is experiencing significant inner shifts related to their core purpose. Resistance to these changes may lead to increased tension. Embracing the transformation and staying aligned with personal growth is advised. The stars indicate that acceptance is key to navigating this period of change and understanding one's true self.

entertainment.title: 'Haiwaan' box office collection day 2: Akshay Kumar, Saif Ali Khan film earns Rs 2.50 cr; 16.7% drop; worldwide gross reaches Rs 8.60 cr
entertainment.summary: 'Haiwaan', starring Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan, experienced a 16.7% drop in box office earnings on its second day, collecting Rs 2.50 crore in India. The film, directed by Priyadarshan, had an opening day collection of Rs 3.00 crore. Its worldwide gross now stands at Rs 8.60 crore, according to reports from Sacnilk.

entertainment.title: Pisces Horoscope Today: September 13, 2026
entertainment.summary: On September 13, 2026, Pisces individuals are encouraged to embrace prosperity and abundance, attributed to their heart-led choices in relationships and work. The cosmos indicates that past efforts will yield positive results, suggesting a time of growth and fulfillment. This alignment emphasizes the importance of emotional connections and authenticity in achieving personal and professional success.
